other_conditions: Must have obtained training or have trained experts or have sufficient experience in the relevant field for managing and running the project.
Must have a sanctioned loan for the project by a bank or financial institution, or provide a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank with project appraisal.
Must own or lease land where the project will be established.
Must possess all relevant KYC documents.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50% direct capital subsidy and 100% subsidy on fodder seed production, together with assistance for procuring machinery such as bailers, block making machines, TMR equipment, and forage harvesters.
